The Theme Settings module allows users to customize the appearance of the library management system. It includes options for selecting between light and dark themes and setting the primary color for the interface. These settings enhance the visual experience and ensure that the interface aligns with the library's branding or user preferences.

Fields and Descriptions

Light Theme:

  • Description: Select this option to apply a light color scheme to the library management system. This theme typically features a light background with darker text.
  • Usage: Choose "Yes" to activate the light theme.
  • Example: "Yes"
  • Validation: Must be a boolean value (Yes/No).

Dark Theme:

  • Description: Select this option to apply a dark color scheme to the library management system. This theme typically features a dark background with lighter text.
  • Usage: Choose "Yes" to activate the dark theme.
  • Example: "No" (if Light Theme is selected)
  • Validation: Must be a boolean value (Yes/No).

Primary Color:

  • Description: Defines the primary color used throughout the interface, including buttons, headers, and links. This color helps in branding and creating a visually appealing design.
  • Usage: Enter a color code or name for the primary color. This can be specified in HEX, RGB, or color name formats.
  • Example: "#3498db" (for a shade of blue)
  • Validation: Must be a valid color code or name supported by the system.
